Likely contributing render-side ambiguity (secondary, not decisive): opponentPunishment.entryCell is c2r1 — the square where the pattern COMPLETES — while the pattern-creating move is c3r1, and both are surfaced in the internal-evidence JSON without distinguishing which one the opponent actually plays.

Run 1 binds c2r1 to two incompatible referents in one sentence — the square the opponent occupies and one of the two still-empty fork ends paired with c6r1. On board 33432 both c2r1 and c6r1 are empty gravity-top winning squares, so the occupation reading is board-false and the reader cannot locate what ‘occupy column 2, row 1’ refers to.
